description: Land Acquisition - Chemmalai, Maritimepattu D/S Division, Mullaithivu District - Manipay, Valikamam South West  D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, locations, and extents. While a government minister is named, the primary focus is on land acquisition matters, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
